conditioning.wall_boundary: Approximately uniform-temperature copper walls, water jacket
conditioning.velocity_boundary: Nominally fully developed after divergent inlet and 36-inch straight inlet length
conditioning.property_basis: Source-reported reduced groups; precise per-run property evaluation not recovered; nominal Pr approximately0.72
conditioning.selection: All32 Appendix7.6 rows retained; no residual-based selection
conditioning.printed_Nu_usage: Retained only for source traceability; not a target, correction or calibration input

limitations: The source describes transition concerns in this facility and supplies no demonstrated uncertainty-backed pure-forced laminar subset.
Downward heated flow can have opposing buoyancy. The equations omit buoyancy and secondary flow; disagreement cannot be causally assigned to one omitted mechanism.
Only centreline velocity evidence is available; source worst stated velocity-measurement accuracy approximately14%, not a propagated experimental error bound.
Thermocouple circuit precision approximately0.05°F is not a complete temperature uncertainty and not a full experimental uncertainty.
Any±0.05°F bounds shown later are explicitly illustrative display-rounding sensitivity assumptions, not confidence intervals.
Source temperature-dependent air properties and approximate wall condition are not reproduced by this constant-property ideal model.
Reported Nu does not exactly reproduce from reported Gz and temperatures. This study uses temperature attenuation and preserves the inconsistency.
Constant-heat-input flow-inversion percentages from other source runs are not transferred to these isothermal runs.
This is an untuned qualified historical comparison, not physical or aircraft validation.
